🚨 BREAKING: The Senate parliamentarian struck the GOP provision that would have spent $1 billion in taxpayer money on Trump’s proposed White House ballroom, according to Senate Budget Committee Democrats.

The parliamentarian ruled that the provision violated the Byrd Rule.

If this is what they do to a sitting member of Congress, imagine what Epstein survivors face when considering whether to come forward.
